description.narrative: The Impact Accelerator (‘IA’) was provided to Invest International by means of a Mandate (Beschikking) dated September 8, 2023. In the Mandate, reference is made to the ODA nature of IA, being provided from BHO Directie Duurzame Economische Ontwikkelingen (DDE). The starting date of the availability of the IA funds was September 1, 2023 with an approved budget of EUR 22,906,347 for commitments until December 31, 2027. The activities that have a high impact score in DGGF countries are funded via the IA and the others via the DA mandate. This can be decided during the project assessment in Invest International’s Investment Committee, using the same way of working when the DC team managed both the PDF and the DA. The IA provides support on the defined combi tracks by Invest International. In the implementation phase of the tracks the IA can provide financing expertise to improve business cases and help structure the right financial support to move the project forwards. This subsidy will be used to cover the associated costs. The transactions financed through the IA are in the pre-project and pre-feasibility phase: bringing stakeholders and project development partners together, scanning for project development opportunities, with a specific focus on the impact and scalability of the business case.
